source_title: Jaundice cases mount to 500 in Shimla (The Tribune)
quote: In 2007, 2010 and 2013, a large number people in the town tested positive for Hepatitis E
notes: Prior hepatitis outbreaks from same source (IJAR paper says 2007 outbreak was hepatitis A). Background risk, not a dated signal.

source_title: Govt apathy led to jaundice outbreak, says NIV report (The Tribune)
quote: Even a high court-appointed committee in July 2009 had asked the government to take 21 measures to maintain not only the Malyana plant
notes: Prior institutional warning about the Malyana STP upstream of Ashwani Khud intake.

source_title: Sewage treatment plant failure leads to jaundice outbreak in Shimla (Down To Earth)
quote: It had stated that only 13 per cent of the sewage generated in Shimla is treated and the rest is left in the open
notes: CAG 2015 report as summarised by Down To Earth (CAG report itself not opened). Exact tabling date not given.

source_title: Sewage treatment plant failure leads to jaundice outbreak in Shimla (Down To Earth)
quote: Deputy Mayor Tikendra Panwar has alleged that despite several complaints to the IPH department, no action was taken against the mismanagement of the STPs.
notes: UNDATED complaints by Shimla MC (Deputy Mayor) to IPH about STP malfunction ('problems for the last few years'). Institutional complaints, not resident complaints; count not stated.

source_title: Bharti OK et al. Early detection of Hepatitis-E/A outbreak in Shimla based on routine IDSP surveillance system. Indian J Applied Research 8(2), Feb 2018
quote: complaints of turbid water supply were received from the affected area.
notes: IDSP/District Surveillance Officer paper. UNDATED; context implies before supply stopped on 2 Jan 2016, but the paper does not say when. latest = 2016-01-02 is my inference from context - treat as soft.

source_title: Bharti OK et al. Early detection of Hepatitis-E/A outbreak in Shimla based on routine IDSP surveillance system. Indian J Applied Research 8(2), Feb 2018
quote: The first case patient developed an illness during second week of December 2015.
notes: Index case onset per outbreak investigation (jaundice/hepatitis; diarrhoea/vomiting not the case definition, so diarrhoea column blank). Paper also says cases 'reported from 11th December 2015'.

source_title: Bharti OK et al. Early detection of Hepatitis-E/A outbreak in Shimla based on routine IDSP surveillance system. Indian J Applied Research 8(2), Feb 2018
quote: In Dec 2015, Integrated Disease Surveillance Project (IDSP) data entry operators informed the District Surveillance Officer that some cases of jaundice are coming daily.
notes: IDSP early signal (jaundice cases daily; clustering in Vikasnagar, supplied from Ashwani Khud). Day not given. DSO then wrote to MC and district administration recommending hyperchlorination (letter undated).

source_title: Jaundice cases mount to 500 in Shimla (The Tribune)
quote: The city witnessed a rise in jaundice cases since the last week of December.
notes: Onset of rise; 'last week of December' -> 24-31 Dec 2015 (my bracketing).

source_title: Jaundice cases mount to 500 in Shimla (The Tribune)
quote: The Ripon hospital is receiving about 20-25 patients of jaundice daily for past 15 days while the IGMC has received about 12-15 cases every day.
notes: Hospital attendance (not necessarily admissions) 'for past 15 days' before 7 Jan 2016 publication -> from ~23 Dec 2015. Daily NEW patients ~32-40 across two hospitals.

source_title: Shimla at high risk of jaundice outbreak due to poor quality drinking water supply: Report (Himachal Watcher)
quote: The team found clear cut mixing of untreated water from the sewerage treatment plants in Ashwini Khud Water Supply Scheme
notes: SMC ward-member committee inspections: Malyana STP visited 31 Dec 2015 (found not functioning properly); Ashwani Khud pumping station visited 2 Jan 2016. Visual inspection, not a lab test.

source_title: Two junior engineers arrested (The Tribune)
quote: The supply from Ashwani Khud was stopped on January 2 after a team of the civic body visited the site and found sewage in the water.
notes: Intervention date (source shut). IJAR paper and Health Minister (Tribune 25 Feb 2016) give the same date.

source_title: Jaundice cases mount to 500 in Shimla (The Tribune)
quote: More than 500 cases of jaundice have been reported in the city in the past few weeks.
notes: CUMULATIVE jaundice cases as of ~6 Jan 2016 (lower bound). Jaundice, not diarrhoea.

source_title: Health Minister reviews steps to tackle jaundice in Shimla town (The News Himachal)
quote: In Shimla town over 820 jaundice cases has been reported and one person lost his life due to this disease.
notes: Health Minister review, 20 Jan 2016. CUMULATIVE.

source_title: Health Minister reviews steps to tackle jaundice in Shimla town (The News Himachal)
quote: In Shimla town over 820 jaundice cases has been reported and one person lost his life due to this disease.
notes: First death: exact date NOT found; only an upper bound (one death reported by 20 Jan 2016). A Tribune 'first victim' article surfaced by search is from Jan 2018 (Sundernagar) and is NOT this outbreak.

source_title: Sewage treatment plant failure leads to jaundice outbreak in Shimla (Down To Earth)
quote: Five people have died and more than 1,000 have been affected in a jaundice outbreak in Shimla.
notes: CUMULATIVE as of 25 Jan 2016. Same article says outbreak 'started in mid-January' (conflicts with Dec 2015 onset in IDSP paper/Tribune) and 50-60 fresh cases/day.

source_title: Shimla, Solan Jaundice Alert: All water samples tested positive for Hepatitis-E (Himachal Watcher)
quote: Eight water samples taken from Ashwani Khud water treatment plants in both cities and the Malyana sewage treatment plant have tested positive for Hepatitis-E.
notes: NIV Pune team visited 28 Jan 2016 'for four days' (sampling 28-31 Jan); report dated 10 Feb 2016. Samples: Ashwani Khud inlet/outlet (Shimla & Solan), Malyana STP, private tanks Chhota Shimla. Post-intervention test (source already shut 2 Jan).

source_title: Bhagra S et al. Bacteriological profile of water samples in and around Shimla hills. Int J Community Med Public Health 2017;4(6):1966-71
quote: A total of 1098 water samples were received in the Microbiology laboratory of which 129 (11.74%) were unsatisfactory
notes: IGMC microbiology, samples from MC Shimla 18 Jan-31 Jul 2016 (post-outbreak). Paper also states 'all samples were found contaminated with total coliforms as well as faecal coliforms' in Jan-Apr - internally inconsistent with 129/1098; recorded as stated.

source_title: Two junior engineers arrested (The Tribune)
quote: Twenty-three more cases were reported, taking the total number to 1,292 in Shimla.
notes: CUMULATIVE jaundice cases as of ~5 Feb 2016; 23 NEW that day.

source_title: Jaundice deaths spark protest in Shimla (The Tribune)
quote: Even as the toll of jaundice deaths at Indira Gandhi Medical College (IGMC) here and the PGI, Chandigarh, has touched nine
notes: Tribune's own tally 23-24 Feb 2016; Health Minister said only 4 deaths the same day. CONFLICT.

source_title: Jaundice has claimed 10 lives: Kaul (The Tribune)
quote: As many as 10 persons have died due to jaundice in Himachal since December 2015 while 1,500 persons were infected.
notes: Health Minister Kaul Singh, 24 Feb 2016. Himachal-wide (includes PGI deaths); 5 of 10 had hepatitis E. Named deaths include [name withheld] (d. 22 Feb, IGMC).

source_title: Jaundice threat looms due to 'misplaced' STPs (The Tribune)
quote: The city has reported more than 1,620 jaundice cases, out of which nine have died, while Solan has reported 620 cases so far.
notes: CUMULATIVE as of ~2 Mar 2016.

source_title: Bharti OK et al. Early detection of Hepatitis-E/A outbreak in Shimla based on routine IDSP surveillance system. Indian J Applied Research 8(2), Feb 2018
quote: There were 33 deaths (case fatality ratio: 1.9%) 90% of them due to HEV.
notes: Final investigation figures (IJAR 2018): 1,681 HEV/HAV cases of >6000 reported 11 Dec 2015-25 May (paper prints '2015', evidently 2016). Peak 13-25 Jan 2016. Much higher than contemporaneous official tolls.
